scope: Broaden the open-source ACIS reader/kernel candidate screen and determine whether a newly available route closes the existing DWG/AcDs-to-semantic-solid evidence chain or changes implementation readiness.

method.kind: Public primary project documentation, API documentation, package metadata, and prior immutable source receipts
method.evidenceBoundary: Public capability descriptions and package/API metadata establish candidate roles only. No peer runtime, actual input/output, target-consumer acceptance, or complete shape-semantic result was generated. The bounded candidate screen does not prove that no other open-source route exists.

findings.observed: The project documents experimental profile-bounded SAT/SAB/ASM parsing and conversion of selected geometry to CadQuery/OpenCASCADE shapes. Unsupported entities can remain raw, and supported geometry depends on save version and producer. The kernel stage is OCCT-based, so it is not an independent kernel result relative to FreeCAD/OCCT. ezdxf separately documents flat-polygon-only ACIS mesh projection and the need for a kernel for curved faces.
doesNotEstablish: behavior of an exact package/source artifact on this repository's bytes
support for all ACIS dialects, entities, producers, or trims
outer DWG/AcDs extraction, owner association, or native application acceptance
findings.planUse: Retain as an optional composed-stage parser-to-shape candidate only for an exact admitted profile, with artifact/dependency pins, full loss reporting, source-body association, and independently authored analytic expectations.

findings.observed: This is a distinct Rust parser for bare ACIS/SAT/SAB payloads with a neutral connected-model transfer path. It is not a DWG/DXF container or AcDs reader and does not supply a general geometric kernel. The reviewed 0.6.1 profile admits only verified ACIS bands; other bands can be decoded by substituted grammar but are explicitly unverified/loss-bearing.
doesNotEstablish: DWG section/page/index parsing or entity-to-body association
DXF ACDSDATA or DWG AcDs correctness
closed B-rep validity or native CAD acceptance
semantic qualification when dialect admission is unverified
findings.planUse: Use only as optional payload-parser evidence after local extraction binds the exact bytes to a source handle/body. Unverified dialect, blocking loss, or shape-relevant unknown records prevent a semantic pass even if a model is returned.

findings.observed: The codec is ACadRust-derived; the separate kernel is described as early, and the application documents per-surface fallback tessellation with incomplete-state reporting. This may provide a distinct consumer/kernel observation, but not an independent DWG/DXF parser vote or a complete-solid result when fallback occurs.
doesNotEstablish: exact release/source behavior on a locally generated control
independence of the outer file parser from ACadRust
semantic success when fallback or incomplete flags are present
findings.planUse: Keep the existing optional one-time consumer/cross-kernel checkpoint; require exact pins, per-body accounting, and no fallback/incomplete state.

findings.observed: The repository describes an MFC viewer that loads/saves SAT through the Spatial ACIS SDK and requires a valid SDK license, Windows/Visual Studio with MFC, and configured SDK libraries. Source availability does not make the parser/kernel implementation open source or provide a cross-platform route.
doesNotEstablish: an open-source ACIS parser or kernel
DWG/DXF/AcDs support or portable Linux/macOS qualification
findings.planUse: Exclude from open-source implementation evidence. A licensed SDK run, if separately authorized and available, must be labeled commercial-tool evidence.

findings.observed: The overview mentions ACIS among many format categories, but the detailed SAT/SAB rows mark read and write unsupported/planned.
doesNotEstablish: a current ACIS parser, writer, or kernel route
that future revisions cannot add such a route
findings.planUse: Keep DISCOVERY_ONLY / ACIS_UNSUPPORTED; repeat a cheap source-table check only if reconsidered later.

existingOwnersOnly: S2/S3 carrier, AcDs, and body-association work
implementationReadiness: Apply a cheap candidate admission stop-rule before cloning, installing, or building a peer.
Continue locally actionable S2/S3/S5/S8 implementation without waiting for external/native evidence.
At one composed checkpoint, bind exact payload bytes to source handle/body and separate parser admission, loss, topology, analytic metrics, and native acceptance.
Keep per-slice validation focused on generated controls and affected strict targets; reserve full suites and multi-peer/native checks for existing composed gates.
Keep generated external controls ephemeral and do not add downloaded or newly authored DWG/DXF fixture files.
